name: Showy Milkweed
pnw_notes: PNW-native milkweed, essential habitat for monarch butterflies. Spreads by rhizome — give it its own patch. Goes fully dormant in winter and emerges late in spring. IMPORTANT: toxic to Jazzy and cats; plant only where pets cannot access. Pink globe flowers July–August.

planting_windows.notes: Transplant potted starts after last frost; cold stratify seed 30 days before sowing
Fall planting mimics natural seed dispersal; good establishment
Flowers July–August; collect mature seed pods in fall before they split open
